objective: Measure local near-bottom hypoxia/stratification state with enough temporal resolution and metadata to support Jubilee forecasting and matched-control calibration.

deployment_geometry.minimum: one near-bottom package fixed above sediment and below typical low-water level
deployment_geometry.preferred: paired near-bottom and near-surface packages to directly estimate vertical salinity/temperature/oxygen gradients
deployment_geometry.bottom_clearance: record exact sensor height above sediment; avoid burial and direct sediment contact
deployment_geometry.reference: survey or repeatedly measure sensor elevation relative to pier structure and local water-level reference

sampling.clock: UTC internally; preserve local Central Time rendering separately

predeployment: two-point DO calibration or manufacturer-equivalent optical DO verification
postdeployment: retain raw uncorrected observations and calibration metadata

telemetry.preferred: automatic local-to-cloud or local-to-desktop delivery without replacing raw logger storage
telemetry.outage_policy: buffer locally and backfill; telemetry outage is missingness, not a physical observation

model_guardrails: No positive production weight until provenance/QC are passing and out-of-sample incremental value is demonstrated.
Near-bottom DO is DIRECT evidence only for the 437/Montrose cell and immediate vicinity; do not generalize as direct Point Clear or Fairhope bottom conditions.
Preserve sensor maintenance, calibration and fouling periods so the model cannot learn instrument-health artifacts.
A paired surface-bottom deployment is preferred because stratification and vertical-gradient features are likely more informative than a single absolute measurement.
future_expansion: Second matched package at Point Clear if the 437 deployment proves stable and informative.
Optional current meter/ADCP only after DO/salinity/temperature logging is reliable.
Trigger standardized manual vertical profiles on high-risk and matched non-event mornings.
